works.title: Real-time 3D generation in mixed reality
works.description: Wearing a Quest 3, he simply says what he wants and it shows up in his room: first an apple, then an info panel about it, then physics so it can fall. A floating orb generates and wires up each request live while he is still talking, with no menus and no controllers.
works.description_zh: 戴着 Quest 3，他只要说出想要什么，东西就出现在房间里：先是一个苹果，然后是一块介绍它的信息面板，接着再加上物理效果让它能掉下来。一个悬浮的光球在他说话的同时就把每个要求生成并接好，全程没有菜单，也不用手柄。
works.idea_en: Speech is the whole authoring tool: objects, interface and behaviour are all added to the room by asking for them one sentence at a time.
works.idea_zh: 说话就是全部的创作工具：物体、界面和行为，都靠一句一句地“要”出来，加进房间里。
works.technique: Voice input goes to an AI coding agent that likely generates the 3D asset and writes and hot-loads the scene code (panel, physics) into the running Quest passthrough app.
works.technique_zh: 语音输入交给一个 AI 编程智能体，它很可能一边生成三维模型，一边写出场景代码（面板、物理）并热加载到正在运行的 Quest 透视应用里。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebXR or phone AR scene with a microphone button: send the spoken request to a language model that returns a small JSON command (spawn a primitive or a library model, attach a label, turn on gravity) and apply it to the scene at once. Twist: allow follow-up sentences that change the last object ("make it bigger", "make it bounce") so the scene is built as a conversation.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个带麦克风按钮的 WebXR 或手机 AR 场景：把说出的要求发给语言模型，让它返回一条简短的 JSON 指令（生成一个基本体或素材库里的模型、贴上标签、打开重力），并立刻作用到场景上。变体：允许用后续的句子修改上一个物体（“大一点”“让它弹起来”），让场景在对话中一步步搭出来。

works.title: AETHER Studio
works.description: A mixed reality music studio that sits on your real desk in Meta Quest 3. You play a rough idea with bare hands, then talk to an AI partner, the Orb: it locks your phrase to the beat, writes a new arrangement, shapes the sound, opens the panel you need and turns the whole piece into another style. Built for the Meta VR Start Developer Competition 2026.
works.description_zh: 一个摆在真实书桌上的混合现实音乐工作室，运行在 Meta Quest 3 上。你先用空手弹出一个粗略的想法，再和 AI 搭档“光球”对话：它把你的乐句对齐到节拍，写出新的编曲，调整音色，打开你需要的面板，还能把整首曲子换成另一种风格。这是为 Meta VR Start Developer Competition 2026 制作的作品。
works.idea_en: Split music-making between hands and voice: the hands sketch the rough phrase on the desk, and a spoken conversation with an AI partner does the editing.
works.idea_zh: 把做音乐分给手和嘴：手在桌面上弹出粗略的乐句，剩下的编辑交给和 AI 搭档的对话。
works.technique: Hand tracking turns the desk surface into playable instruments, and a voice-driven AI agent likely edits the recorded notes as data (quantise, rearrange, change instruments) and controls which interface panels are open.
works.technique_zh: 手部追踪把桌面变成可以弹奏的乐器；语音驱动的 AI 智能体很可能把录下的音符当作数据来编辑（量化、重新编曲、更换音色），并控制打开哪些界面面板。
works.exercise_en: Make a hand-tracked desk drum or keyboard in WebXR or Unity that records a short loop of notes, then add one spoken command that sends the note list to a language model and plays back its edited version (for example "tighten the timing" or "make it a waltz"). Twist: remove every button, so recording, undo and style changes all happen by voice.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 或 Unity 里做一个用手部追踪演奏的桌面鼓或键盘，录下一小段循环音符；再加一条语音指令，把音符列表发给语言模型，并播放它改过的版本（例如“把节奏对齐”或“改成华尔兹”）。变体：去掉所有按钮，让录音、撤销和换风格全部靠说话完成。

works.title: Who Let the Flies In?
works.description: A hand-tracked mixed reality game for Meta Quest in which flies buzz around your real room and you catch them with a pair of virtual chopsticks. A 60-second Frenzy mode is the core, with Survival, Thief Raid and Overdrive modes to unlock. Made for the Meta VR Start Developer Competition 2026.
works.description_zh: 一款用手部追踪玩的 Meta Quest 混合现实游戏：苍蝇在你真实的房间里嗡嗡乱飞，你要用一双虚拟筷子把它们夹住。核心玩法是 60 秒的 Frenzy 模式，之后还能解锁 Survival、Thief Raid 和 Overdrive 模式。这是为 Meta VR Start Developer Competition 2026 制作的作品。
works.idea_en: Take one famously hard, precise hand skill (catching a fly with chopsticks) and make it the whole game, played in your own room.
works.idea_zh: 把一个出了名难的精细手上功夫（用筷子夹苍蝇）做成整个游戏，就在自己的房间里玩。
works.technique: Hand tracking maps the pinch of thumb and fingers to the opening of a pair of virtual chopsticks, and a catch likely counts when a fly is between the tips as they close; the flies fly through the passthrough view of the room.
works.technique_zh: 手部追踪把拇指与手指的捏合映射为虚拟筷子的开合，筷尖合上时苍蝇正好在中间，很可能就算夹住；苍蝇在透视画面里的房间中飞来飞去。
works.exercise_en: Attach two thin sticks to a tracked hand in WebXR or Unity so that the pinch distance opens and closes them, spawn small targets that wander around the room, and count a catch when the tips close around one. Twist: swap the tool for another everyday precision skill (tweezers, a fly swatter, a butterfly net) and compare how each changes the way people move.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 或 Unity 里给被追踪的手装上两根细棍，用捏合的距离控制它们的开合；在房间里生成四处乱飞的小目标，筷尖合拢夹住目标就记一分。变体：把工具换成另一种日常的精细动作（镊子、苍蝇拍、捕虫网），比较每种工具怎样改变人的动作。

works.title: $50 LiDAR Sensor + ARKit 3D Scanning
works.description: A roughly $50 ST VL53L9CX LiDAR sensor sits on the back of an iPhone in a 3D-printed MagSafe mount and plugs in over USB-C. ARKit supplies the phone's position, and the small sensor's 54x42 depth zones become live meshes, coloured point clouds and a scan of a whole apartment, without using the iPhone's own LiDAR.
works.description_zh: 一枚约 50 美元的 ST VL53L9CX LiDAR 传感器，用 3D 打印的 MagSafe 支架贴在 iPhone 背面，通过 USB-C 接入。ARKit 提供手机的位置，这枚小传感器的 54x42 个深度分区就变成了实时网格、彩色点云，甚至扫出了整套公寓，全程没有用 iPhone 自带的 LiDAR。
works.idea_en: Tracking and sensing can be separated: let AR tracking say where the device is, and almost any cheap sensor becomes a 3D scanner.
works.idea_zh: 定位和感知可以拆开：让 AR 追踪负责回答“设备在哪里”，几乎任何便宜的传感器都能变成三维扫描仪。
works.technique: Each frame of the direct time-of-flight sensor (up to 2,268 points) is placed in world space with the ARKit camera pose at that moment and coloured from the camera image; the accumulated points are meshed live in a Swift and Metal app.
works.technique_zh: 直接飞行时间传感器的每一帧（最多 2,268 个点）都按当时的 ARKit 相机位姿放进世界坐标，并用摄像头画面上色；累积起来的点在一个 Swift 加 Metal 写的应用里实时生成网格。
works.exercise_en: Tape any cheap sensor to a phone (an ultrasonic distance sensor, a thermometer, a light meter or a Wi-Fi strength reading), log its value together with the AR camera pose, and drop a coloured dot in space for every sample to build a 3D map of that measurement. Twist: map something invisible, such as temperature or signal strength, and let classmates guess what the cloud of dots shows.
works.exercise_zh: 把任意一个便宜的传感器（超声波测距、温度计、照度计，或者 Wi-Fi 信号强度读数）绑在手机上，把读数和 AR 相机位姿一起记录下来，每采一次样就在空间里放一个彩色小点，画出这个量的三维分布图。变体：去测一种看不见的东西，比如温度或信号强度，让同学猜这团点云画的是什么。

works.title: Ask the AI Agent on My Own Machine from Even G2 Glasses
works.description: His first Even G2 app lets him ask questions from the glasses to an AI agent (Hermes Agent) running on his own machine at home. The app is a web app hosted on that same machine instead of Even's site, so the agent that answers can also edit the app: he plans to tell it to fix or change whatever bothers him while he is using it.
works.description_zh: 这是他的第一个 Even G2 应用：在眼镜上就能向家里自己电脑上运行的 AI 智能体（Hermes Agent）提问。应用本身是一个网页应用，没有放在 Even 的官方站点上，而是托管在同一台电脑上，所以回答问题的智能体也能修改这个应用：他打算一边用，一边让它把不顺手的地方当场改掉。
works.idea_en: Host the glasses app next to the AI that answers you, so the interface can be rewritten by asking for changes while you wear it.
works.idea_zh: 把眼镜应用和回答你的 AI 放在同一台机器上，这样戴着眼镜提要求，界面就能当场被改写。
works.technique: The Even G2 app is a web app served from a home machine that also runs a local AI agent; questions from the glasses are forwarded to the agent, which has file access to the app's own source.
works.technique_zh: Even G2 应用是一个由家用电脑提供服务的网页应用，这台电脑上同时运行着本地 AI 智能体；眼镜上的提问被转发给智能体，而智能体可以直接读写这个应用自己的源代码。
works.exercise_en: Serve a one-page web app from a laptop and open it on a phone or headset browser; add a text or voice box that sends requests to a coding assistant with permission to edit that page's file, then reload to see the change. Twist: spend ten minutes using the app while walking around and only improve it by asking, then compare the result with the first version.
works.exercise_zh: 用笔记本电脑提供一个单页网页应用，在手机或头显的浏览器里打开；加一个文字或语音输入框，把要求发给一个有权修改这个页面文件的编程助手，刷新后查看变化。变体：边走边用这个应用十分钟，只靠提要求来改进它，再和最初的版本比一比。

works.title: DIY Pocket Eye Tracker
works.description: A fully mobile eye tracker built for about $150 from an infrared camera, a front camera, a Raspberry Pi or Orange Pi and a battery bank. It can be mounted on glasses, head-worn displays or helmets for gaze analysis and costume design, and the video compares the cost and performance of the two boards and shares tips for better accuracy. Parts list, build steps and software are open.
works.description_zh: 一台完全便携的眼动仪，用红外摄像头、前置摄像头、Raspberry Pi 或 Orange Pi 加一块充电宝搭成，总价约 150 美元。它可以装在眼镜、头戴显示器或头盔上，用于注视分析和服装道具设计；视频里比较了两种开发板的成本和性能，还分享了提高追踪精度的技巧。零件清单、搭建步骤和软件全部公开。
works.idea_en: Gaze input does not need a lab device: a pocket-sized, open eye tracker lets anyone prototype attention-driven wearables.
works.idea_zh: 注视输入不需要实验室设备：一台能放进口袋的开源眼动仪，让任何人都能做出由注意力驱动的可穿戴原型。
works.technique: An infrared camera with IR filters films the eye, open-source pupil-detection code on a Raspberry Pi or Orange Pi estimates gaze direction, and a second front camera shows the scene the wearer is looking at.
works.technique_zh: 带红外滤光片的红外摄像头拍摄眼睛，Raspberry Pi 或 Orange Pi 上的开源瞳孔检测代码估算注视方向，另一个前置摄像头拍下佩戴者正在看的场景。
works.exercise_en: Track gaze with what you have (this build, a headset with eye tracking, or a laptop webcam with WebGazer) and make one thing in the room or on screen respond only when it is looked at, for example a lamp that brightens or a character that looks back. Twist: make the object react when you look away from it instead.
works.exercise_zh: 用手头的工具追踪视线（这套自制设备、带眼动追踪的头显，或者笔记本摄像头加 WebGazer），让房间里或屏幕上的一样东西只在被注视时才有反应，比如一盏会变亮的灯，或一个会回看你的角色。变体：改成当你把视线移开时它才有反应。

works.title: WATERLICHT
works.description: Luminous blue waves of light move above the heads of thousands of visitors in Iveagh Gardens, Dublin, on 13 and 14 November 2026, so that walking through the garden feels like standing below sea level. The installation, first shown in the Netherlands in 2015, shows how high the water could reach and was presented here for Science Week 2026.
works.description_zh: 2026 年 11 月 13 日和 14 日，在都柏林的 Iveagh Gardens，发光的蓝色光波在数千名观众头顶上方流动，走在花园里就像站在海平面以下。这件装置 2015 年首次在荷兰展出，它让人看到水可能涨到多高，这次是在 Science Week 2026 期间展出。
works.idea_en: Draw an invisible level in the air at full scale, above people's heads, and a number about sea-level rise becomes something a crowd stands inside.
works.idea_zh: 把一条看不见的水位线按真实尺度画在人们头顶的空中，海平面上升的数字就变成了一群人置身其中的体验。
works.technique: Likely LED light sources with lenses project flat sheets of blue light through haze and mist, so the moving beams read as a rippling water surface overhead.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是用带透镜的 LED 光源，把一片片蓝光打进烟雾和水汽里，流动的光束在头顶看起来就像起伏的水面。
works.exercise_en: Place a translucent, gently rippling plane in AR at a meaningful height in a real place (a historic flood mark, a projected sea level, the old ground level of a street) and walk under it with a phone or headset. Twist: make the plane's height follow live or historical data, so the level rises and falls as visitors scrub through the years.
works.exercise_zh: 在一个真实地点，把一块半透明、轻轻起伏的平面用 AR 放在一个有意义的高度（历史洪水线、预测的海平面，或一条街道过去的地面高度），拿着手机或戴着头显从它下面走过。变体：让平面的高度跟随实时或历史数据，观众拖动年份时，水位随之升降。

leads.name: JeffXR (Conference Confetti)
leads.why: Conference Confetti, a universal conference guide for Even G2 glasses that loads an event's sessions, speakers and expo floor plan; featured in Even Realities' Built by You, Episode 3 (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ODC9BmNwZdA). Own upload and wider AR work not yet researched.
